mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transfer_log (txn_no, request_no, from_user_id, to_user_id, amount, currency, status) VALUES (#{txnNo}, #{requestNo}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{status.code})
mapper.select: SELECT id, txn_no, request_no, from_user_id, to_user_id, amount, currency, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM transfer_log WHERE txn_no = #{txnNo}
SELECT id, txn_no, request_no, from_user_id, to_user_id, amount, currency, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM transfer_log WHERE request_no = #{requestNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE transfer_log SET status = #{status.code}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE txn_no = #{txnNo}
